001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.rulecmd;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.InteractionDialogAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc.Token;
012
013/**
014 * SetPersonHidden set person hidden boolean by character id
015 */
016public class SetPersonHidden extends BaseCommandPlugin {
017        
018        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
019                
020                PersonAPI person;
021                boolean hidden;
022                
023                // if only the bool parameter is given, assume it's the conversation target... if they exist.
024                if (params.size() == 1) {
025                        SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
026                        if (entity.getActivePerson() == null) return false;
027                        person = entity.getActivePerson();
028                        hidden = params.get(0).getBoolean(memoryMap);
029                }
030                // if a person id is given (so, 2 params), we shall follow The Old Ways
031                // if you wanted to just pass in the person ID. The person has to have been
032                // added to ImportantPeople at some point (as the people defined in People are)
033                else {
034                        String id = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
035                        person = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople().getPerson(id);
036                        hidden = params.get(1).getBoolean(memoryMap);
037                }
038                
039                //VarAndMemory var = params.get(0).getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
040                //PersonAPI person = (PersonAPI) var.memory.get(var.name);
041                
042                if (person == null || person.getMarket() == null) return false;
043                if (person.getMarket().getCommDirectory() == null) return false;
044                if (person.getMarket().getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person.getId()) == null) return false;
045
046                person.getMarket().getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person.getId()).setHidden(hidden);
047                return true;
048                
049        }
050}
